subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Be in seventh heaven

options.text: To be in a state of extreme happiness
To avoid talking about what’s important

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Be in seventh heaven"** means to be in a state of **extreme happiness or bliss**. (अत्यधिक प्रसन्नता की स्थिति में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **When she received the news of her promotion, she **was in seventh heaven.**
 
 
 
• **"To be in a state of extreme happiness" **means to feel very joyful and content. (अत्यंत खुश और संतुष्ट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **was in a state of extreme happiness** after winning the lottery.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of idiom is '**To be in a state of extreme happiness'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To be ignored** (अनदेखा किया जाना): To not be noticed or considered.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt hurt when her contributions** were ignored** during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **To start performing better** (बेहतर प्रदर्शन करना शुरू करना): To begin improving in performance or ability.
 
 
• **Example:** After months of practice, he **started performing **better in his exams.
 
 
 
• **To avoid talking about what's important** (जो महत्वपूर्ण है उसके बारे में बात करने से बचना): To deliberately not discuss or address significant issues.
 
 
• **Example:** He kept **avoiding talking about what's important** and focused on trivial matters instead.
 
 

3b1:T10c9,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
